role: Re-runs Emuqu unit-test expectations (EmuquTests @ e028039: DFAAnalysisTests, DFAReferenceValidationTests, FrequencyDomainTests, HRVSleepStageClassifierTests, ArtifactDetectionTests, LiveDFAAnalyzerTests, TimeDomainTests, HRVReferenceValidationTests) against the Python ports; each @case registers a runner that records PASS/FAIL; exits 1 on any failure. Output is committed as test_ports_output.txt (114/114).
state: RESULTS list of (suite, name, ok, detail) (line 21)
toplevel: Imports the six port modules and swift_rng; module-level @case decorators register 114 runners in CASES; the __main__ block (lines 1040-1048) runs every case, prints PASS/FAIL lines and 'N/M cases matched', exits 1 if any failed. Not referenced by any .github workflow, so port drift from Swift is only caught when someone reruns it by hand.

flags.text: The ports and this suite are pinned to commit e028039 and are not run in CI (no workflow references Tools/validation); a later change to the ported Swift methods would leave RESULTS.md, which the white papers cite, silently describing old code. At main 8d32097 only comment lines of LiveDFAAnalyzer.swift changed since e028039.

units.does: Decorator factory: case(suite, name) returns deco, which wraps a test function in a runner and appends it to CASES; the original function is returned (so all `_` names shadow each other harmlessly).

Runner: calls the case function, records (suite, name, ok, detail) in RESULTS; any exception is recorded as a FAIL with the exception repr.
